doan_van.noi_dung:
> Last summer, Mai and her family went to Sapa. They travelled by night train and arrived early in the morning. The weather was cold and foggy, but they enjoyed it. They stayed in a small hotel near the market. Every morning Mai got up at six and walked around the town. On the second day, they visited a local village and bought some handmade clothes. Mai didn’t want to leave. Next year, she’s going to go back with her friends.

1. How did they travel to Sapa?
1. What was the weather like?
1. Where did they stay?
1. What did they buy?
1. What is Mai’s plan for next year?

doan_van.noi_dung:
Nói liền mạch 3 phần:

1. Một ngày bình thường của bạn (hiện tại đơn + trạng từ tần suất)
1. Kể lại kỳ nghỉ gần nhất (quá khứ đơn, ≥6 động từ bất quy tắc)
1. Kế hoạch 6 tháng tới (going to + will + present continuous)

**Tiêu chí đạt:** không im quá 5 giây · chia đúng thì ở ≥80% số câu · đọc đúng đuôi -ed · có ít nhất 3 trạng từ tần suất đặt đúng vị trí.

doan_van.ten: Bí ẩn - Chiếc vali biến mất
doan_van.noi_dung: Nam grabs his heavy suitcase and runs to the airport. The gate display shows his flight is ready but the plane sits empty on the runway. He feels confused because his ticket clearly says boarding time is now. A man in a uniform walks past and drops a small metal key. Nam picks it up and opens a locker near the gate. Inside sits his own suitcase with his name on the tag. He realises his original bag was a decoy planted by a rival traveller to delay him.

doan_van.ten: Cảm động - Đôi tay lặng lẽ của Nam
doan_van.noi_dung: Nam rubs his frozen fingers while waiting for the bus in the heavy rain. He carries his sister Nhung old heavy books to the library for her. The water drips from his thin jacket onto his shaking legs. He reaches the building and leaves the bag by the door without saying a word. Nam turns around and walks back into the cold downpour with empty hands. He feels the warmth of his sister smile in his heart. His clothes are soaked but he feels light.

huong_dan.noi_dung:
**Chia động từ (1–12):**

1. She ____ (visit) her aunt last week.
1. ____ you ____ (go) to the party yesterday?
1. I ____ (not/have) time last night.
1. He usually ____ (get) up at 6.
1. Look! It ____ (rain).
1. They ____ (buy) a house two years ago.
1. I ____ (meet) my friend at 8 tomorrow. (đã hẹn)
1. She ____ (not/like) coffee.
1. We ____ (be) very tired yesterday.
1. I’d like ____ (book) a room.
1. He can ____ (swim) very well.
1. I enjoy ____ (cook) at the weekend.

**Điền There is / There are / Is there / Are there (13–16):**
13. ____ two bedrooms in my flat.
14. ____ any milk in the fridge?
15. ____ a supermarket near here.
16. ____ not any chairs in this room.

**Chọn many / much / a few / a little (17–20):**
17. How ____ money do you have?
18. There are ____ people outside.
19. I only have ____ time.
20. How ____ books did you buy?

**Đặt trạng từ tần suất đúng vị trí (21–23):**
21. I go to the gym. (usually)
22. She is late. (never)
23. They eat out. (sometimes)

**Điền giới từ (24–30):** at, on, in, by, of
24. I get up ____ 7 o’clock.
25. My birthday is ____ July.
26. We meet ____ Monday.
27. I go to work ____ bus.
28. She went there ____ foot. *(bẫy!)*
29. There’s a book ____ the table.
30. A bottle ____ water, please.

Viết từ tiếng Anh:
31. thức giấc 32. tủ lạnh 33. thực đơn 34. giảm giá 35. ngã tư
36. nhiều mây 37. hoãn lại 38. biên lai 39. rau củ 40. ban công
41. hủy 42. ẩm 43. mặc thử 44. dự báo 45. hiếm khi

mini_story.ten: Bí ẩn - Chiếc vali biến mất
mini_story.truyen: Nam grabs his heavy suitcase and runs to the airport. The gate display shows his flight is ready but the plane sits empty on the runway. He feels confused because his ticket clearly says boarding time is now. A man in a uniform walks past and drops a small metal key. Nam picks it up and opens a locker near the gate. Inside sits his own suitcase with his name on the tag. He realises his original bag was a decoy planted by a rival traveller to delay him.

mini_story.ten: Cảm động - Đôi tay lặng lẽ của Nam
mini_story.truyen: Nam rubs his frozen fingers while waiting for the bus in the heavy rain. He carries his sister Nhung old heavy books to the library for her. The water drips from his thin jacket onto his shaking legs. He reaches the building and leaves the bag by the door without saying a word. Nam turns around and walks back into the cold downpour with empty hands. He feels the warmth of his sister smile in his heart. His clothes are soaked but he feels light.
